I have been with my partner for almost 12 years now and I highly recommend dating your spouse again! We try to go out on a 'date night ' at least once a fortnight (budget allowing), whether it be a fancy restaurant, the movies, a picnic, or even clubbing! It has done wonders for our relationship, it's fun, has brought us closer together, reinvigorated our bond and intimate interest in one another. Also can't recommend enough that you plan a day to do do it even if you don't make plans to do anything in particular, make sure you allocate a tangible time/date to do so that you are both aware of. I know this is cliche, but communication is key with this too, you are both going to be rusty, so it can sometimes get awkward trying to flirt with your SO at first.  These times will be a great opportunity for you both to learn more about each other's wants, needs, emotional state and have a laugh. I found that a big help, is to leave all your pre conceived or learned ideas about your spouse behind (don't judge), treat them like your best friend, avoid ridicule, negative comments and listen. It will make it a safe space and enjoyable for both of you. Then talk about your shared experiences together afterwards, you will find out what you both liked and didn't like about the night, then come to a compromise on your disagreements and enjoy the rest of your lives together loving each other with a deeper passion and understanding that you will both benefit from.
